claims: AeroVironment, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAV) is based in Arlington, VA.
AeroVironment, Inc. has a record $1.1 billion backlog.
AeroVironment, Inc. produces small UAS (sUAS) for intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) for defense and commercial customers.
AeroVironment, Inc. produces the Switchblade® loitering munition.
AeroVironment, Inc. produces the new Red Dragon™ one-way attack drone.
AeroVironment, Inc. provides counter-UAS (C-UAS) defense against hostile drones, including laser systems like "Locust".
AeroVironment, Inc. develops unmanned platforms for High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellite (HAPS) long-endurance, high-altitude missions.
AeroVironment, Inc. is expanding manufacturing capabilities, including a new facility in New Mexico to support increased demand.
For the quarter ending January 31, 2026, AeroVironment reported $408.05 million in revenue.
For the quarter ending January 31, 2026, AeroVironment experienced a net loss.
The 12-month average price target for AVAV has been projected around $303.
